baseline.instrument: e04_seam_sources.py — the instrument, not this file, defines the measurement

hypothesis: A LoRA trained on provenance-gated asset turnaround packages reduces co-visible deltaE between independently generated views of a NEW near-canon subject, versus the identical pipeline without the LoRA. Scope: appearance lock + view-token vocabulary (Kumari 2024, Cheng 2024) — NOT cross-view consistency machinery, which the literature places at 30K+ objects with cross-view attention (SyncDreamer ablation).
prediction_support: with-LoRA median co-visible deltaE < same-session no-LoRA arm's, on a majority of view pairs
prediction_falsified: deltaE not reduced or worsened — kills the flywheel premise at its first link; the lane remains a packaging/provenance surface
controls: same pipeline, same seed policy, same prompts — the LoRA is the only variable
the live no-LoRA arm outranks the historical 17.97 baseline
evaluation subject is NOT any training asset
preconditions_before_running: multi-subject style pool per the Q3 composition rules (never a single asset)
a watchdog-disciplined training session with the Director's go
